question: Найден ли исходный код, создающий 531 features PTB-XL+ ECGDeli?
answer: Скрипт, который пишет features/ecgdeli_features.csv, не найден. Найдены beat-level функции ECGDeli 1.1 и текстовое описание агрегации в статье.

primary_sources.citation: Strodthoff et al., Scientific Data, 13 May 2023
primary_sources.what_it_contains: Описание: признаки считаются по каждому комплексу, в таблицу попадают медиана, (0.25, 0.75)-IQR и count. Код агрегации не приложен.

primary_sources.name: PTB-XL+ 1.0.1
primary_sources.what_it_contains: Готовые features/ecgdeli_features.csv, features/feature_description.csv и fiducial_points/ecgdeli/*.atr. Скрипта сборки CSV в дереве файлов нет.
Код обучения и оценки моделей. Читает уже готовый CSV.
Делинеация и beat-level матрицы. Не пишет 531-колоночный CSV.

repositories.note: Полная история просмотрена. Удалённые notebooks/evaluate_rfs.ipynb и notebooks/feature_comparison.ipynb — оценка уже готовых таблиц. Раньше загрузчик читал kit_features_final.csv, затем путь заменён на features/ecgdeli_features.csv.
Публичная страница репозитория не содержит скрипта агрегации PTB-XL+.

feature_families.name: PQ_Int
feature_families.dictionary_global_wording: max PQ interval across all leads
feature_families.function_global_definition: 2nd-latest QRS onset minus 2nd-earliest P onset, not a call to max()

feature_families.name: P_Amp
feature_families.beat_level: leadwise amplitude index 1, raw sample value

feature_families.name: P_DurFull
feature_families.beat_level: leadwise column 1, P offset minus P onset
feature_families.dictionary_wording: Sum of P and P' wave duration

feature_families.name: P_Morph
feature_families.beat_level: integer codes -3,-2,-1,1,2,3 per beat and lead

feature_families.name: QT_IntCorr
feature_families.beat_level: per-lead Framingham is named QTci_X in feature_description.csv

feature_families.name: ST_Elev
feature_families.dictionary_wording: ST elevation/depression from multiple Gaussian fits in lead X
feature_families.l_point_in_T_Detection: sample index only, no exported ST amplitude

feature_families.name: QT_IntFramingham
feature_families.beat_level: sync column 7, Framingham of that beat's sync QT and RR

feature_families.name: HA
feature_families.dictionary_wording: integer axis 1 left, 2 horizontal, 3 normal, 4 vertical, 5 right, 6 extreme right

confirmed_parameters.paper_reports: median across beats, (0.25, 0.75) interquartile range as one reported variability number, and beat count
confirmed_parameters.units_after_harmonization: mV for amplitudes, ms for intervals
confirmed_parameters.interval_function_sample_scale: differences of fiducial sample indices are multiplied by 2; the function does not take a sampling frequency
confirmed_parameters.sync_qtc_formula: per beat: QTc_ms = QT_ms + 154 * (1 - RR_ms/1000), using the synchronized QT and RR of that beat

whether QT_IntFramingham_Global is the median of sync column 7
sampling frequency passed to ECGDeli for PTB-XL+
filter, notch, isoline, baseline and Annotate_ECG_Multi process_flag used for the dataset
lead reorder from WFDB order to the CSV lead order
byte equality of Zenodo ECGDeli zip md5 d6e176cc0b1f12a17e0db5ce589c8ee1 and git tag v1.1
contents of the earlier concept version of DOI 10.5281/zenodo.3944620
